
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(edgeR)
```

```{r}
rna = read.csv("data/raw rna/thyroid_rna_counts_112.csv")
tumor_samples = read.csv("data/1tumor_samples_final_68.csv")
normal_samples = read.csv("data/1normal_samples_final_32.csv")

rna = rna %>%
  dplyr::select(
    1,
    any_of(c(tumor_samples$sample_id, normal_samples$sample_id))
  )
```

```{r}
rna_counts = as.matrix(rna[, -1])

rownames(rna_counts) = rna[[1]]

storage.mode(rna_counts) = "numeric"

stopifnot(
  ncol(rna_counts) == 100,
  !anyNA(rna_counts),
  all(rna_counts >= 0),
  all(tumor_samples$sample_id %in% colnames(rna_counts)),
  all(normal_samples$sample_id %in% colnames(rna_counts))
)
```

```{r}
tumor_counts = rna_counts[
  ,
  tumor_samples$sample_id,
  drop = FALSE
]

normal_counts = rna_counts[
  ,
  normal_samples$sample_id,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  ncol(tumor_counts) == 68,
  ncol(normal_counts) == 32
)
```

```{r}
keep_tumor = rowSums(tumor_counts >= 10) >= 3

tumor_counts_filtered = tumor_counts[
  keep_tumor,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dge_tumor = DGEList(
  counts = tumor_counts_filtered
)

dge_tumor = calcNormFactors(
  dge_tumor,
  method = "TMM"
)

tumor_logcpm = cpm(
  dge_tumor,
  log = TRUE,
  normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
keep_normal = rowSums(normal_counts >= 10) >= 3

normal_counts_filtered = normal_counts[
  keep_normal,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dge_normal = DGEList(
  counts = normal_counts_filtered
)

dge_normal = calcNormFactors(
  dge_normal,
  method = "TMM"
)

normal_logcpm = cpm(
  dge_normal,
  log = TRUE,
  normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
tumor_gene_var = apply(
  tumor_logcpm,
  1,
  var
)

top500_tumor = names(
  sort(tumor_gene_var, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:min(500, length(tumor_gene_var))]

pca_tumor = prcomp(
  t(tumor_logcpm[top500_tumor, , drop = FALSE]),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

normal_gene_var = apply(
  normal_logcpm,
  1,
  var
)

top500_normal = names(
  sort(normal_gene_var, decreasing = TRUE)
)[1:min(500, length(normal_gene_var))]

pca_normal = prcomp(
  t(normal_logcpm[top500_normal, , drop = FALSE]),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
percent_var_tumor = 100 * pca_tumor$sdev^2 / sum(pca_tumor$sdev^2)

pca_tumor_df = as.data.frame(pca_tumor$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(
    tumor_samples %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, group),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

percent_var_normal = 100 * pca_normal$sdev^2 / sum(pca_normal$sdev^2)

pca_normal_df = as.data.frame(pca_normal$x) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(
    normal_samples %>%
      dplyr::select(sample_id, group),
    by = "sample_id"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_tumor_df, aes(
  x = PC1,
  y = PC2,
  color = group
)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "WTC-unexposed" = "dodgerblue4",
      "WTC-exposed" = "firebrick3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Thyroid Tumor Samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(percent_var_tumor[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(percent_var_tumor[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "WTC Exposure"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}
ggplot(pca_normal_df, aes(
  x = PC1,
  y = PC2,
  color = group
)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "WTC-unexposed" = "dodgerblue4",
      "WTC-exposed" = "firebrick3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Adjacent Normal Thyroid Samples",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(percent_var_normal[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(percent_var_normal[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "WTC Exposure"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic()

```
